title: Two nonzerodivisors in a one-dimensional local ring acquire a common factor after a finite blowup
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology), section preparing the key lemma
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma turns a pair of nonzerodivisors in a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring into a pair with a common factor after a finite ring extension killed by a power of the maximal ideal (statement lines 567-572). The proof replaces the plausible algebraic argument by a geometric one: it blows up R in I = (a, b), shows the blowup is finite over Spec(R) by combining projectivity, the fact that all generic points lie over the punctured spectrum, and the finite-in-codimension-one criterion, and then uses that a locally principal ideal over the resulting semi-local ring is principal, which produces t with a = a't, b = b't (proof lines 578-601). The non-routine content is precisely this combination: finiteness of the blowup is what makes R' a ring of the required shape, and semi-locality is what upgrades locally principal to principal. The claim is H2.
